books.title: 猜猜我有多爱你
books.reason_zh: 把爱说出口的经典范本，大小兔子用身边事物比爱，睡前亲子共读必收。
books.reason_en: The classic for saying 'I love you' in concrete ways; perfect bedtime bonding read.

books.title: 爷爷变成了幽灵
books.reason_zh: 把死亡讲得温柔又幽默，祖孙情动人，孩子生命教育绕不开的经典。
books.reason_en: Gently and humorously opens the door to death and remembrance; essential life education.

books.title: 狐狸的窗户
books.reason_zh: 安房直子唯美童话，桔梗花汁搭出魔法小窗，意境忧伤诗意，大童文学启蒙佳作。
books.reason_en: Awa's poetic fairy tale of a magic window and longing; a beautiful literary read for older kids.

books.title: 后来呢后来怎么了
books.reason_zh: 用天马行空的想象聊死亡与天堂，轻松不沉重，孩子笑着学会直面生命课题。
books.reason_en: Death imagined with wild humor and warmth; kids learn to face big questions with a smile.

books.title: 你看起来好像很好吃
books.reason_zh: 凶猛霸王龙被小甲龙叫爸爸，反差萌催泪又温暖，宫西达也爱与善良代表作。
books.reason_en: A fierce T. rex becomes a dad; tear-jerking and warm, Miyajima's signature tale of love.

books.title: 活了100万次的猫
books.reason_zh: 死了100万次的猫第一次为自己流泪，爱与生命的哲学寓言，常读常新。
books.reason_en: A cat that died a million times finally learns to love; a fable that stays with you.

books.title: 抵岸
books.reason_zh: 无字图像小说，电影般画面讲述移民的艰辛与希望，大童审美与共情进阶之选。
books.reason_en: Wordless graphic novel of migration and hope; cinematic art for mature young readers.

books.title: 不一样的卡梅拉（1-10册）
books.reason_zh: 敢想敢做的母鸡一家笑点密集，从共读到自读的桥梁书，法式幽默启蒙首选。
books.reason_en: A bold little hen's funny adventures; ideal bridge books from read-aloud to solo reading.

books.title: 海底的秘密
books.reason_zh: 一台神奇相机串起海底奇观，无字书大师的想象力盛宴，细节百看不厌。
books.reason_en: Wiesner's wordless fantasy of a magical undersea camera; endless details to pore over.

books.title: 四季时光
books.reason_zh: 无字情境认知书天花板，一座小镇四季流转，每页都能编出新故事，超耐读。
books.reason_en: Wordless seasonal town where every page births a new story; endlessly re-readable.

books.title: 永远永远爱你
books.reason_zh: 慈母龙妈妈养育霸王龙宝宝，讲透爱无关血缘，亲情主题催泪经典。
books.reason_en: A mother dinosaur raises a T. rex; love beyond blood, deeply moving.

books.title: 月亮忘记了
books.reason_zh: 坠落的月亮与孤独男孩互相陪伴，几米诗意治愈，适合大童读出温柔与勇气。
books.reason_en: Ji Mi's poetic tale of a lonely boy and the fallen moon; gentle comfort for growing hearts.

books.title: 小熊宝宝绘本（全15册）
books.reason_zh: 低幼生活习惯启蒙鼻祖，吃饭刷牙问好全覆盖，圆滚滚画风宝宝一看就爱。
books.reason_en: Toddler classic covering meals, brushing and greetings; adorable and gentle.

books.title: 时光电影院
books.reason_zh: 用一场场电影串起对妈妈的思念与成长，几米治愈长篇，共读有泪点。
books.reason_en: Movies weave a girl's longing for her lost mother; a moving Ji Mi growth story.

books.title: 妈妈，买绿豆！
books.reason_zh: 买绿豆煮绿豆种绿豆，平凡日常写出最浓母子情，生活气息满分的经典。
books.reason_en: Buying, cooking and planting mung beans; everyday warmth between mother and son.

books.title: 这是苹果吗也许是吧
books.reason_zh: 一个苹果引出上百种可能，脑洞与哲思兼备，点燃孩子发散思维的想象力神书。
books.reason_en: One apple sparks a hundred possibilities; a wonder-machine for divergent thinking.

books.title: 星空
books.reason_zh: 两个孤独少年逃离城市共赏星空，几米成长治愈代表作，适合小学高年级。
books.reason_en: Two lonely teens find healing under the stars; Ji Mi's coming-of-age classic.

books.title: 失落的一角遇见大圆满
books.reason_zh: 极简线条寓言讲成熟与依赖，大人孩子各有读法，谢尔经典的人生启蒙课。
books.reason_en: A minimalist fable on maturity and independence; new meaning at every age.

books.title: 田鼠阿佛
books.reason_zh: 收集阳光颜色和词语的小田鼠，肯定精神生活的价值，李欧·李奥尼哲学绘本。
books.reason_en: The mouse who gathers sunshine and words; celebrates imagination and self-worth.

books.title: 爱心树
books.reason_zh: 一棵有求必应的树陪男孩一生，付出与索取的经典寓言，亲子谈爱的入口。
books.reason_en: A giving tree and a boy across a lifetime; the classic parable of love and giving.

books.title: 爷爷一定有办法
books.reason_zh: 旧毯子变外套背心领带，重复节奏朗朗上口，画面里老鼠一家藏双线彩蛋。
books.reason_en: Grandpa turns a blanket into treasures; rhythmic text plus a hidden mouse subplot.

books.title: 奥菲利娅的影子剧院
books.reason_zh: 平凡老姑娘收留影子办剧院，米切尔·恩德诗意哲理，教孩子优雅面对孤独与死亡。
books.reason_en: A humble woman shelters shadows and finds light; Ende's poetic wisdom on loss.

books.title: 花婆婆
books.reason_zh: 「做一件让世界更美的事」，花婆婆一生践行的浪漫约定，价值观启蒙必收。
books.reason_en: 'Do something to make the world more beautiful'; a lifelong promise kept.

books.title: 我的爸爸叫焦尼
books.reason_zh: 单亲孩子与爸爸相聚的一天，不卖惨只讲爱，离异家庭孩子的温柔安慰。
books.reason_en: A boy's precious day with his dad; tender comfort for children of split families.

books.title: 晚安，大猩猩
books.reason_zh: 调皮大猩猩偷钥匙放出全动物园，几乎无字却笑点满满，睡前共读神器。
books.reason_en: A gorilla's near-wordless zoo breakout; pure bedtime comedy gold.

books.title: 夏天守则
books.reason_zh: 哥哥的奇怪规则与弟弟的挫败爆发，超现实画面讲透手足关系，话题感十足。
books.reason_en: Weird brotherly rules and a little brother's breaking point; surreal sibling insight.

books.title: 不可思议的旅程
books.reason_zh: 红笔画什么成什么，无字冒险如电影般流畅，想象力与观察力双练，三部曲开篇。
books.reason_en: A magic red pen opens a wordless cinematic quest; fuels imagination and focus.

books.title: 7号梦工厂
books.reason_zh: 小男孩闯入云端梦工厂管起不听话的云，无字书想象力狂欢，百看不厌。
books.reason_en: A boy runs the cloud factory in the sky; Wiesner's wordless wonder.

books.title: 坏狐狸
books.reason_zh: 装凶失败的狐狸孵蛋当了鸡妈妈，法式冷幽默加反差萌，同名动画电影也好看。
books.reason_en: A fox who fails at being fierce raises chicks; French deadpan humor, pure charm.

books.title: 铁丝网上的小花
books.reason_zh: 二战题材经典，女孩视角见证集中营悲剧，灰冷画面震撼，和平与良知教育必读。
books.reason_en: A girl's quiet witness to WWII horror; powerful peace and conscience education.

books.title: 点点点
books.reason_zh: 按一按摇一摇点点就变魔术，互动性拉满的魔法书，把娃从屏幕前拉回书前。
books.reason_en: Press, shake and the dots work magic; irresistible interactive fun, screen-free.

books.title: 小兔彼得和他的朋友们（全3册）
books.reason_zh: 波特小姐23篇田园童话全收录，小兔彼得百年经典，文学美育双重滋养。
books.reason_en: Beatrix Potter's complete pastoral tales; a century of literary and visual nourishment.

books.title: 好饿的毛毛虫
books.reason_zh: 洞洞书加变蝴蝶，数数认星期认食物全囊括，低幼认知启蒙第一书。
books.reason_en: Die-cut pages and metamorphosis; counting, weekdays and food in one classic.

books.title: 松鼠先生和月亮
books.reason_zh: 「月亮」掉进屋里原来是块奶酪，荒诞误会喜剧，钢笔线描画风笑点密集。
books.reason_en: The 'fallen moon' is just cheese; an absurd, hilarious misunderstanding comedy.

books.title: 白兔夫人
books.reason_zh: 爱丽丝白兔家的番外日常，精致画面埋满幽默细节，读爱丽丝后更有味。
books.reason_en: The White Rabbit family's witty home life; richer fun after reading Alice.

books.title: 朱家故事
books.reason_zh: 妈妈罢工后父子变猪的超现实讽喻，轻松聊家务分工与家庭平等，安东尼·布朗代表作。
books.reason_en: When Mom leaves, dad and sons turn into pigs; witty lesson on sharing housework.

books.title: 小房子
books.reason_zh: 小房子看乡村变城市又回归自然，城市化议题诗意图景，凯迪克金奖经典。
books.reason_en: A house watches the countryside become city; poetic Caldecott classic on change.

books.title: 逃家小兔
books.reason_zh: 妈妈永远追得上逃跑的小兔，爱的捉迷藏流行一甲子，低幼安全感奠基之作。
books.reason_en: Every runaway bunny is found; the original game of love, sixty years strong.

books.title: 桃花源的故事
books.reason_zh: 陶渊明《桃花源记》绘本版，蔡皋画风古朴动人，古典文学启蒙（建议增设人文主题）。
books.reason_en: Tao Yuanming's Peach Blossom Spring in pictures; gateway to Chinese classics (suggest humanities theme).

books.title: 蓝莲花
books.reason_zh: 丁丁远赴中国历险结识挚友张，经典冒险漫画（章节式桥梁书），适合大童自主阅读。
books.reason_en: Tintin's China adventure with his lifelong friend Chang; classic comic for independent readers.

books.title: 野兽国
books.reason_zh: 撒野男孩在野兽国称王又想回家，直面孩子怒气的凯迪克金奖，情绪教育鼻祖。
books.reason_en: A wild boy kings the beasts and sails home; Caldecott gold on handling anger.

books.title: 雪人
books.reason_zh: 全无字却温暖满格，男孩与雪人的奇妙一夜，搭配同名动画更佳。
books.reason_en: Wordless winter magic between a boy and his snowman; pair with the beloved film.

books.title: 爱德华的奇妙之旅
books.reason_zh: 瓷兔子学会爱与被爱的旅程，纽伯瑞银奖章节书，适合大童自主阅读。
books.reason_en: A china rabbit learns to love; Newbery Honor chapter book for solo readers.

books.title: 小金鱼逃走了
books.reason_zh: 在窗帘糖果罐里找小金鱼，专注力观察力训练鼻祖，低幼游戏书天花板。
books.reason_en: Hunt the runaway goldfish through every page; the original toddler seek-and-find.

books.title: 当鸭子遇见死神
books.reason_zh: 死神温柔陪伴鸭子走完最后旅程，哲思版生命教育，安徒生奖作者之作。
books.reason_en: Death gently walks with a duck; a philosophical, tender classic on mortality.

books.title: 小狐狸买手套
books.reason_zh: 狐狸妈妈放手让小狐狸独自进城，温柔讲信任与善意，入选小学语文课本。
books.reason_en: A mother fox lets her kit brave town alone; tender trust and kindness, textbook favorite.

books.title: 鳄鱼怕怕牙医怕怕
books.reason_zh: 病人牙医互相害怕的双视角神作，幽默化解看牙恐惧，刷牙教育必收。
books.reason_en: Scared patient, scared dentist; humor melts dentist fear and builds brushing habits.

books.title: 肚子里有个火车站
books.reason_zh: 把消化系统画成肚子火车站，吃太快小精灵会罢工，饮食习惯科普神书。
books.reason_en: Digestion as a busy train station in your belly; science that fixes eating habits.

books.title: 不可思议的朋友
books.reason_zh: 真实故事改编，与自闭症男孩二十年的友谊，同理心与包容教育首选绘本。
books.reason_en: A true-story friendship with an autistic boy spanning twenty years; empathy at its best.

books.title: 小蓝和小黄
books.reason_zh: 小蓝小黄抱在一起变绿，用色块讲友谊与自我，李欧·李奥尼天才成名作。
books.reason_en: Little Blue hugs Little Yellow and turns green; Lionni's genius debut on friendship.

books.title: 大猩猩
books.reason_zh: 冷冰冰的爸爸和有魔法的大猩猩，超现实讲孩子对陪伴的渴望，安东尼·布朗经典。
books.reason_en: A magical gorilla answers a lonely girl's wish for dad; Browne's classic on companionship.

books.title: 你好灯塔
books.reason_zh: 守塔人一家与世隔绝的坚守，凯迪克金奖，细腻画面讲责任与爱。
books.reason_en: A lighthouse keeper family's devoted life; Caldecott Medal art of duty and love.

books.title: 糖球
books.reason_zh: 吃下糖球能听见他人心声，从孤单到主动交朋友，白希那共情治愈神作。
books.reason_en: Magic candies let a boy hear others' hearts; Baek Heena's empathy-filled healing tale.

books.title: 小黑鱼
books.reason_zh: 李奥尼经典，小黑鱼教同伴协作自救，智慧与勇气的启蒙，画面极美。
books.reason_en: Lionni's classic: one small fish teaches teamwork and courage. Gorgeous art.

books.title: 我讨厌妈妈
books.reason_zh: 小兔子满腹牢骚又离不开妈妈，幽默道尽亲子小情绪，共读更贴心。
books.reason_en: A bunny's funny complaints about mom end in love; perfect parent-child read.

books.title: 蚯蚓的日记
books.reason_zh: 日记体幽默绘本，蚯蚓视角看世界，笑点密集还顺带自然知识。
books.reason_en: Diary-style picture book; a worm's-eye view packed with humor and nature facts.

books.title: 亲爱的小鱼
books.reason_zh: 十四句诗讲尽爱与放手，猫和鱼的温情童话，低幼共读入门佳作。
books.reason_en: Fourteen poetic lines about love and letting go; a tender cat-and-fish tale.

books.title: 蹦!
books.reason_zh: 重复拟声词Beng贴合宝宝语感，动物蹦跳引发模仿，早教互动神器。
books.reason_en: Repeating Beng sounds captivate babies; jumping animals invite imitation.

books.title: 团圆
books.reason_zh: 原创中国风，春节里打工爸爸的归家与告别，亲情最浓的年味绘本。
books.reason_en: Chinese original about Spring Festival reunion; tender father-daughter love.

books.title: 我爸爸
books.reason_zh: 孩子眼中无所不能的爸爸，夸张又幽默，亲子情感启蒙必读。
books.reason_en: A child's awe of dad rendered with warmth and humor; a must-read classic.

books.title: 我妈妈
books.reason_zh: 与《我爸爸》成对，孩子心中的超人妈妈，夸张幽默满溢爱意。
books.reason_en: Paired with My Dad; the super-mom through a child's eyes, funny and loving.

books.title: 棕色的熊、棕色的熊，你在看什么？
books.reason_zh: 一问一答韵律感强，认颜色认动物，低幼认知与朗读启蒙双料经典。
books.reason_en: Rhythmic Q&A teaching colors and animals; a toddler read-aloud staple.

books.title: O先生
books.reason_zh: 无字漫画荒诞幽默又引人深思，适合大童自主阅读；漫画书（大童档）。
books.reason_en: Wordless absurdist comic; thought-provoking fun for independent readers.

books.title: 獾的礼物
books.reason_zh: 用隧道与礼物温柔讲死亡与怀念，生命教育入门首选，感动而不沉重。
books.reason_en: A gentle introduction to loss and remembrance; the go-to book on death.

books.title: 玛德琳
books.reason_zh: 巴黎街景配韵文叙事，勇敢又有个性的小女孩，经典长销不衰。
books.reason_en: Rhymed Paris adventure of a brave little girl; an enduring classic.

books.title: 和甘伯伯去游河
books.reason_zh: 格林纳威奖经典，甘伯伯的包容让规则教育不着痕迹，孩子百读不厌。
books.reason_en: Greenaway Medal classic; gentle rule-setting via Mr. Gumpy's river ride.

books.title: 抱抱
books.reason_zh: 近乎无字，小猩猩找妈妈的拥抱之旅，低幼亲情启蒙第一书。
books.reason_en: Almost wordless; baby gorilla's search for a hug warms every reader.

books.title: 当世界年纪还小的时候
books.reason_zh: 舒比格奇想童话集，用想象力回答世界从哪来，适合大童慢慢品；故事集（非典型绘本）。
books.reason_en: Schubiger's whimsical creation tales; imaginative reading for older kids.

books.title: 是谁嗯嗯在我的头上
books.reason_zh: 小鼹鼠破便便案，爆笑中学动物习性，科普启蒙的幽默入口。
books.reason_en: A mole's poop-detective quest; hilarious gateway to animal facts.

books.title: 让路给小鸭子
books.reason_zh: 凯迪克金奖，鸭子一家过马路，全城人为生命让路，温情又幽默。
books.reason_en: Caldecott winner; a city stops for a duck family crossing, warm and witty.

books.title: 牙齿大街的新鲜事
books.reason_zh: 把蛀牙细菌画成野心建筑队，孩子看完主动刷牙，习惯养成利器。
books.reason_en: Cavity germs as ambitious builders; kids brush their teeth after this.

books.title: 大卫，不可以
books.reason_zh: 凯迪克银奖，淘气包大卫照见每个孩子，规则之外永远是爱。
books.reason_en: Caldecott Honor; naughty David mirrors every kid, wrapped in love.

books.title: 小石狮
books.reason_zh: 熊亮原创中国风，小石狮守望小镇一生，文字极简余韵悠长；建议增设人文主题。
books.reason_en: Xiong Liang's Chinese original; a small stone lion keeps watch with grace.

books.title: 要是你给老鼠吃饼干
books.reason_zh: 因果接龙环环相扣，爆笑循环里练预测与逻辑，经典共读之选。
books.reason_en: Endless if-then chain reaction; hilarious loop that builds prediction.

books.title: 勇气
books.reason_zh: 散文诗罗列日常勇气片段，帮孩子自信面对未知，朗读友好。
books.reason_en: Prose-poem listing everyday courage; helps kids face the unknown bravely.

books.title: 迟到大王
books.reason_zh: 伯宁罕讽刺幽默，为说谎的孩子鸣不平，想象与思辨并重。
books.reason_en: Burningham's satire defends a liar's wild imagination; sharp and funny.

books.title: 月亮的味道
books.reason_zh: 小动物叠罗汉够月亮，凹凸画面触感十足，合作分享的睡前书。
books.reason_en: Animals stack up to taste the moon; tactile art and teamwork at bedtime.

books.title: 约瑟夫有件旧外套
books.reason_zh: 凯迪克金奖，旧外套一路改造，变废为宝的乐观与巧思。
books.reason_en: Caldecott winner; Joseph's coat keeps transforming, celebrating ingenuity.

books.title: 当世界还不存在的时候
books.reason_zh: 34个造物奇想接龙成书，脑洞大开的世界起源故事，亲子朗读佳品；故事集（非典型绘本）。
books.reason_en: 34 whimsical creation tales relayed by two authors; great read-aloud.

books.title: 爱花的牛
books.reason_zh: 不爱打斗爱花香的公牛费迪南，做自己的温柔宣言，历久弥新。
books.reason_en: Bull Ferdinand prefers flowers to fights; a gentle ode to being yourself.

books.title: 我喜欢你
books.reason_zh: 极简图文把友谊说透，文字浅白情感真挚，朗读治愈又温暖。
books.reason_en: Minimal words capture what friendship means; warm, simple, soothing.

books.title: 月亮，生日快乐
books.reason_zh: 小熊对着山谷送月亮生日礼物，万物有灵的童心，友谊启蒙暖心之作。
books.reason_en: A bear gifts the moon a birthday hat; pure toddler warmth and friendship.

books.title: 石头汤
books.reason_zh: 三个和尚煮石头汤，分享让村庄重新温暖，禅意东方叙事经典。
books.reason_en: Monks cook stone soup to unlock a village's sharing; zen-inspired classic.

books.title: 母鸡萝丝去散步
books.reason_zh: 文字极简画面爆笑，狐狸的连环倒霉事全靠读图，低幼视觉幽默开端。
books.reason_en: Sparse text, hilarious art; the fox's mishaps reward every re-read.

books.title: 独生小孩
books.reason_zh: 纽约时报年度最佳，无字黑白梦境里的孤独与想象，读图力练兵场。
books.reason_en: NYT Best Illustrated; wordless dream of a lonely child, stunning art.

books.title: 风到哪里去了
books.reason_zh: 用诗意见答万物去向，自然循环的温柔科普，睡前哲学小课。
books.reason_en: Poetic answers about where wind goes; gentle nature-cycles bedtime talk.

books.title: 一片叶子落下来
books.reason_zh: 一片叶子答尽生命之问，生命教育经典，大童共读更有滋味。
books.reason_en: A leaf answers life's big questions; the classic on life and death.

books.title: 我不知道我是谁
books.reason_zh: 兔子达利B哲学三连问，自我认知启蒙，幽默又好读。
books.reason_en: A rabbit's identity questions; funny primer on knowing yourself.

books.title: 孤单的小狗
books.reason_zh: 奈良美智绘本首作，大到无人看见的小狗，孤独与陪伴的温柔共情。
books.reason_en: Nara's first picture book; a too-big dog nobody sees, tender and warm.

books.title: 奥莉薇
books.reason_zh: 精力旺盛的小猪奥莉薇把人累昏，每个小大人的影子，黑色幽默。
books.reason_en: Olivia the tireless piglet; every spirited child will recognize herself.

books.title: 安的种子
books.reason_zh: 原创禅意绘本，三种心态种千年莲花，教孩子学会等待与从容。
books.reason_en: Chinese zen fable; three ways to plant a lotus seed, about patience.

books.title: 大脚丫跳芭蕾
books.reason_zh: 被嫌弃大脚的贝琳达重回舞台，讲偏见与坚持，自信启蒙好素材。
books.reason_en: Big-footed ballerina dances again; about prejudice and persistence.

books.title: 菲菲生气了
books.reason_zh: 火山式的愤怒被画得淋漓尽致，情绪认知与平复的第一课。
books.reason_en: Rage painted as a volcano; the first lesson in taming big feelings.

books.title: 三只小猪的真实故事
books.reason_zh: 狼版三只小猪讲真相，媒体视角引入，思辨启蒙的绝佳范本。
books.reason_en: The wolf's side of the story; a playful start to critical thinking.

books.title: 三个强盗
books.reason_zh: 黑斗篷强盗被小女孩感化建福利院，黑暗画风下的善意反转经典。
books.reason_en: Robbers transformed by a girl's innocence; kindness wins the night.

books.title: 第五个
books.reason_zh: 五个受伤木偶排队等修理，极简悬念化解就医与未知的恐惧。
books.reason_en: Five broken toys wait in line; minimal art dissolves fear of the unknown.

books.title: 驴小弟变石头
books.reason_zh: 魔法石让驴小弟变石头，落点是家的温暖，凯迪克金奖经典。
books.reason_en: A magic stone turns Sylvester to rock; family love brings him home.

books.title: 彩虹色的花
books.reason_zh: 花瓣一片片送出，四季轮回里的给予，分享与奉献的启蒙经典。
books.reason_en: A flower gives away every petal; a lovely lesson in giving across seasons.

books.title: 瞬间收藏家
books.reason_zh: 画家岛上的秘密画展，每幅画都是一个世界，艺术与想象的美学启蒙。
books.reason_en: A painter's secret island exhibition; an invitation to art and imagination.

books.title: 小小的王国
books.reason_zh: 凯雷特写给孩子的寓言，关于付出与成全，篇幅不长余味悠长。
books.reason_en: Keret's fable of the smallest kingdom; about giving, loss, and grace.

books.title: 一园青菜成了精
books.reason_zh: 北方童谣改编，蔬菜大战押韵过瘾，语文韵律与想象力双收。
books.reason_en: Vegetables battle in a rollicking Chinese nursery rhyme; rhythm and fun.

books.title: 我变成一只喷火龙了
books.reason_zh: 赖马式爆笑，生气就喷火的阿古力想尽办法灭火，情绪管理具象化。
books.reason_en: Lai Ma's laugh-out-loud tale of a fire-breathing temper, tamed at last.

books.title: 荷花镇的早市
books.reason_zh: 原创水乡早市长卷，江南烟火与人间温情，带孩子逛一次纸上大集；建议增设人文主题。
books.reason_en: A scroll-like walk through a Jiangnan morning market; warm local color.

books.title: 灶王爷
books.reason_zh: 原创民俗绘本，灶王爷的大眼睛照见人心，年节文化启蒙首选；建议增设人文主题。
books.reason_en: The Kitchen God's big eyes watch every household; folk culture for kids.

books.title: 最可怕的一天
books.reason_zh: 温柔同理上台恐惧，不说教地帮孩子说出害怕，画面细节丰富。
books.reason_en: Stage fright met with warmth and humor; reassures kids who dread big days.

books.title: 我看见一只鸟
books.reason_zh: 原创自然观察绘本，母女追查陌生野鸟，认鸟入门的图鉴式故事。
books.reason_en: A mother-daughter bird-watching quest; illustrated guide to wild birds.
